cohort: 1227 pregnant women who delivered between April 15, 2020, and October 15, 2021, at KIST Medical College and underwent COVID-19 screening
finding: Among delivering pregnant women, COVID-19 prevalence was 3.6%, disease severity was generally low, and perinatal outcomes were favorable, indicating a good overall prognosis for mothers and newborns.
mod_finding: The study found a 34.1% cesarean rate among COVID-19 positive pregnant women.
